fishing: WHEN: Tuesday Oct 6. Boca Grande low 3:09a (1.2 ft), high 9:46a (1.9 ft), low 4:51p (0.4 ft), high 11:39p (1.4 ft). Lemon Bay sunrise/sunset about 7:24a / 7:10p. Fair bite windows about 6:54a-8:54a and 5:40p-7:40p. SE around 5 kt becoming SW, light chop, showers possible. Snook harvest open in Charlotte Harbor / SW through Nov 30 (slot 28-33, 1/day). PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/2 surf at Stump Pass, Blind Pass and Boca Grande — baby black drum, whiting, small snook, overslot redfish, ladyfish to 30 inches; mornings and evenings best. Beach trough edges still holding redfish and snook, with ladyfish, bluefish and trout mixed in. LEMON BAY: 10/2 docks and mangroves holding mangrove snapper, small black drum, redfish and snook; a few trout on the grass. NEARSHORE: West Wall south half lots of redfish, snook picked up after the weak front (treeline, deeper cuts). Placida mangrove snapper fewer but bigger; a few sharks near Gasparilla Pass. Gulf bottom mostly weathered off. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters last posted report is June (summer tarpon); no October bite note. Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, pinfish, gold spoons, topwater. Whitebait tiny and scattered.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Sarasota samples); not observed in Charlotte, including Englewood Beach and Stump Pass. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 9/28 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/4). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU on 9/21, no advisory.
fpl: Morning check: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 148 customers out; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
